steps.title: Analyze Build Failures
steps.description: Inspect the compilation logs of HistoryActivity.java to pinpoint invalid sp-to-px helper utility calls.

steps.title: Correct TextView Font Sizing
steps.description: Replace malformed custom sizing calls with valid, standard Android float inputs inside setTextSize.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure no lambdas, stream APIs, or other Java 9+ features are used in the modified codebase.

steps.title: Confirm App Metadata Integrity
steps.description: Validate assets/app-meta.json to confirm correct app_id configurations for synchronizing backend data.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Layouts
steps.description: Verify that AndroidManifest.xml contains correct activity structures and references the default Material theme.

steps.title: Verify Drawables and Style Properties
steps.description: Confirm custom golden button states and custom input drawables are correctly defined and referenced.

steps.title: Run Integration Compilation Checks
steps.description: Validate card view allocations and margins to ensure History list rendering functions flawlessly.

steps.title: Verify Network Client Serialization
steps.description: Ensure the JSON collection parsers are robustly aligned to retrieve 'bookings' from the Cloud Beta Worker API.

steps.title: Perform Clean Build Preparation
steps.description: Clear compilation cache files to prevent residual resource conflicts or build collisions.

steps.title: Building BarberQ
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to finalize compilation of the debug build after resolving all code violations.
